questionText:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the question that follows:

"Space technology and satellite communications have revolutionized the acquisition and analysis of geographical data in India. The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), established in 1969, has positioned India among the elite spacefaring nations of the world. India maintains two major operational satellite constellations: the Indian National Satellite (INSAT) system for telecommunications, television broadcasting, and meteorological disaster warning, and the Indian Remote Sensing (IRS) satellite system for natural resource management. questionText:

(B) Welfare Approach
(C) Basic Needs Approach
(D) Capability Approach

List-II (Parameters)
(I) Building human abilities in the areas of health, education and access to resources
(II) People are not participants in development but only passive recipients

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Fundamentals of Human Geography (Chapter 3: Human Development, 'Approaches to Human Development'):
- Income Approach: One of the oldest approaches, linking human development directly to income levels (III).

- Basic Needs Approach: Proposed by the International Labour Organisation (ILO), identifying six basic needs (IV).

Matching: (A)-(III), (B)-(II), (C)-(IV), (D)-(I).
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.
